metadata.name: [SRE] OpenSearch CPU > 95
metadata.description: P1 OpenSearch CPUUtilization > 95 for 15m. Clone of Splunk CPUUtilization critical.

breach.query:
FROM metrics-aws.cloudwatch_metrics-*
| WHERE @timestamp >= ?_tstart AND @timestamp < ?_tend
| WHERE aws.cloudwatch.namespace == "AWS/ES" AND aws.dimensions.NodeId IS NOT NULL
| STATS cpu = MAX(aws.es.metrics.CPUUtilization.avg)
    BY aws.dimensions.DomainName, aws.dimensions.NodeId, cloud.account.id, cloud.region
| WHERE cpu > 95
| KEEP aws.dimensions.DomainName, aws.dimensions.NodeId, cloud.account.id, cloud.region, cpu
